summary: Full backend + frontend smoke pass for HITL Approval Queue iteration 3. All 15 backend behaviors validated (health, state, inventory, orders, approve happy/error paths, reject validation, webhook create/invalid-SKU, typed 409 failures, persistence across supervisor restart). Frontend end-to-end verified: approval-page loads, OrderDecisionCard renders, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK failure alert surfaces with typed code, reject flow (form + preset + confirm) works and DITOLAK marker + bot reject message + audit entries appear. Inventory panel reflects stock deductions (SRG-TNN-04 5->4 after approve).
passed: GET /api/health returns ok with orders count
GET /api/v1/state returns inventory[5], orders[7+], audit[] with correct camelCase keys (customerAlias, rejectReason, totalPrice, receivedAt, orderId in audit)
POST /api/v1/orders/ORD-2406-004/approve: status->approved, 3 audit entries (APPROVE_ORDER human, DEDUCT_STOCK agent, NOTIFY_CUSTOMER agent), bot message appended, SRG-TNN-04 stock 5->4
POST approve on ORD-2406-001 (already approved) -> 409 ORDER_NOT_PENDING
POST reject with reason<5 chars -> 422 pydantic validation error
POST reject ORD-2406-003 with valid reason -> status=rejected, rejectReason stored, 3 messages
POST /api/v1/webhook/whatsapp creates ORD-2609-009 (status pending_approval, 2 seed messages, INBOUND_MESSAGE audit)
POST webhook with invalid SKU -> 409 PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND
POST approve ORD-2609-009 (99x KBY-ENC-03, stock 2) -> 409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK with context {operation:check_stock, order_id, sku}
Persistence: after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, ORD-2406-004 remains approved, SRG-TNN-04 stock remains 4, audit preserved
Frontend: approval-page loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, 9 queue items rendered
Frontend: order-failure-alert shows INSUFFICIENT_STOCK code + message for ORD-2609-009

Frontend reject flow: reject-reason-form -> reject-preset-reason-0 -> reject-confirm-button transitions ORD-2609-008 to DITOLAK, appends bot rejection message, updates audit log panel, decreases pending count 3->2

failed.issue: queue-item testids are lowercased (e.g. `queue-item-ord-2609-008`) while spec/docs referenced upper-case order IDs (`queue-item-ORD-2609-008`). Selectors still work if callers use lowercase.
